question: Analyze the Spearman correlation between gene expression and gene essentiality scores across common cell lines. Identify the top 5 and bottom 5 correlated genes and visualize the scatter plot of the top correlated gene.

expected_output.guidelines: The 5 bottom-correlated gene records must match the reference in identity and Spearman r within +/-0.001; column order may differ.
The 5 top-correlated gene records must match the reference in identity and Spearman r within +/-0.001; column order may differ.
Scatter plot of expression vs. inverted essentiality for the top gene; Spearman r annotation must be visible; marker styling and colors may differ.
